label: Trend-following pullback (H1 context, M15 pullback, M5 trigger)

rules.context: H1 EMA fast vs slow (completed H1 bar)
rules.pullback: M15 close on the pullback side of EMA fast, still on the trend side of EMA slow
rules.trigger: completed M5 reversal candle closing beyond EMA fast in the trend direction
rules.stop: min/max of last 5 completed M5 bars +/- buffer
rules.extra_exit: opposite H1 EMA cross at candle close

cost_basis.note: Mean of MT5's per-bar spread field (points) x point. A genuine measured value but a per-bar approximation, not a tick-level spread series, and not the same as a live spread snapshot.

assumptions: Entry is simulated at the confirming candle's close (no slippage modelled).
A still-open position is marked to the final close and reported as end_of_data.
Same-candle stop/target uses the conservative stop-first rule unless exact-tiling M1 evidence proves the target first.
P&L is mark-to-market via default_calc_profit (volume * price move); no real broker calculation is used.
Risk limits and position sizing use the same RiskPolicy and size_position maths as the Fibonacci backtest.

Enforceable gates match the Fibonacci backtest: per-trade/aggregate/daily budget, max open positions, stop-distance bounds, spread cap and a daily-loss lockout that clears at the next day's rollover. Drawdown and consecutive losses are reported as metrics, not hard gates, for comparability.

daily.note: The target is a SOFT objective. days_reaching_target is a historical count, not a promise; a negative mean day or a high losing-day rate means the target was not achieved on average.

limitations: Daily P&L is grouped by the trade's exit time in UTC; broker-day boundaries may differ.
The target is a soft objective and is reported as a historical count of days that reached it, never as a promise.
A small number of trading days cannot establish a daily-profit edge.

volatility_regime.method: ATR(14) terciles over the window (low/mid/high volatility)
